task.title: Procedure for Protecting against Physical Security Issues
task.shortdesc: A list of policies to follow in order to protect your hardware and software for physical security threats

taskbody.context: Physical security threats are an important concern when it comes to cybersecurity. Physical access to your device can lead to data breaches for both you and your institution.

step.cmd: Do not leave your laptop unattended in public at any point.
Lock access to your devices when they are not in use.
Do not plug anything into your device unless you trust it completely.
Keep any documentation that has your passwords in it in a physically secure location.
Do not charge your device with a public USB port without a data blocker.
Do not thro away your device without proper precautions.
